basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old tech enthusiast from Wellington, New Zealand. I work as a systems administrator for a mid-sized IT company, where I've been for the last 10 years. My interests include building custom PCs, binge-watching anime (particularly 'Gintama'), and exploring the latest tech trends. I tend to browse Reddit during my downtime, usually late at night or on weekends. I'm married with two children, and we enjoy spending time outdoors when the weather allows. I dislike misinformation and enjoy engaging in meaningful discussions about technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology and have been working in the IT field for over a decade. My expertise in PC hardware and software is mainly self-taught through hands-on experience, online courses, and active participation in tech forums.
